rows.role_title: Presidente Nacional do Partido dos Trabalhadores
rows.text: The national PED coordinator, Francisco Campos, announced early in the evening of Tuesday 11 October 2005 that deputy Ricardo Berzoini, the party's national secretary-general, could already be considered president-elect of the PT: the fourth partial bulletin (95.6% counted) gave Berzoini 112,348 votes (51.6%) and Raul Pont 105,257 (48.4%).
